question: After winner-aware placement correction, do the frozen Trust Governor, Capacity Operator, and parity-calibrated AGI Candidate pass the complete strategy-ecology contract under unchanged physical rules?

selectionRule.balance: Select only if every three-, four-, and five-player faction, seat, profile, diversity, fallback, and forced-no-op bound passes with no credible homogeneous or pairwise dominance.
selectionRule.measuredDefects: Winner-aware pairwise cells must not recreate the invalid raw-Mandate dominance. The three- and five-player profile ranges and five-player winning-path entropy must pass rather than inheriting the descriptive failures in v1.
selectionRule.trustIdentity: Trust Governor must average at least one Influence selection per appearance, keep Influence below its largest Core Action, reach Trust 4 in at least 85 percent of appearances, and retain mean Mandate of at least 16.
selectionRule.capacityIdentity: Capacity Operator must average at least two Build selections per appearance, select Research plus Deploy more often than Build, and retain mean Mandate of at least 16.
selectionRule.agiIdentity: AGI Candidate must be the largest profile contributor to AGI-declaration winner credit, supply at least 30 percent of that credit overall, retain mean Mandate of at least 14, and keep Dossier as its highest Program weight.
selectionRule.rulesBoundary: The study changes deterministic profile policy and evidence placement only. Physical rules and faction starting states remain canonical.
selectionRule.failure: Any failed supported-count bound, credible winner-aware dominance, or identity check rejects canonical profile promotion. Repeated corrected failure may nominate a separate physical mechanism study, but cannot itself select a physical change.

requiredDiagnostics: profile Action selections and Mandate sources
profile and faction win shares by supported player count
AGI emergence and winner override rates
